import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();plan=dict(url='https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcta.2011.02.005',routes=['318479'],destination='sources/target-final.payload',source_identity='Gutschwager JCTA118 2011 1829-1842 final Generalised stretched LR coefficients DOI10.1016/j.jcta.2011.02.005',purpose='Compare actual final publication Conjecture5.5 scope against saved arxiv v3')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'plans/get-target-final.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'source_get_guard.py'),str(p/'plans/get-target-final.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr)
if r.returncode==0: print((p/'sources/target-final.payload').read_bytes()[:4000])
